summary: Iteration 47 tested new features: bulk cert regeneration endpoint, upgraded per-member send-email endpoint (subject/HTML body/CC/attachments/WhatsApp channel), CMS byelaws_pdf_url persistence, admin UI Regen button, upgraded email modal with rich text/toggles/dynamic send button, CMS byelaws upload section, and public About page rendering. All 8 backend pytest cases passed; frontend flows verified via Playwright — Regen button present, email modal shows all required controls (Email/WhatsApp toggles, Subject, CC, Quill toolbar, Attachments, dynamic send button text 'Send Email/Send WhatsApp/Send Both'), CMS Byelaws PDF section renders under SEO tab (which also contains the CC Email section), and About page renders without JS errors (byelaws section hidden since URL empty).

issues: The 'IDSEA Byelaws PDF' section is placed on the 'SEO & Indexing' tab (alongside Favicon, Site URL, Membership Email CC). The problem statement said 'under the CC Email section' which is technically true, but placing byelaws PDF upload under an SEO tab is semantically odd — consider a dedicated 'Documents' tab or moving both CC Email and Byelaws to a more discoverable location for admins.

action_items: OPTIONAL/UX: Consider moving the 'IDSEA Byelaws PDF' section out of the SEO tab into a dedicated Documents or Global tab for better discoverability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (6367 lines) — recommend splitting into modules (members, cms, email, certs) for maintainability.
In /admin/members/{id}/send-email, when member has no email but send_email=True, endpoint silently skips and only reports whatsapp. It should return a warning/message so UI can inform admin.
In regenerate-certificates, no membership_type filter validation — invalid strings silently return empty. Consider validating against known types.

background_tasks in regenerate-certificates could block if many members (5000 limit) — consider chunked/async worker with progress polling; a background_tasks doc is inserted at completion only, so status polling before completion is not possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (cert regen, upgraded email modal, WhatsApp channel, CMS byelaws PDF, About page PDF flipbook) confirmed working. Auth login endpoint is /api/auth/login (not /api/admin/login) — remember for future test scripts. Iteration 46's verify-ID modal and approval blocking were NOT re-tested per instructions.
